prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: finished portrait storybook chapter title cover, 1024x1536 pixels, full bleed.
Primary request: Make a beautiful warm dimensional woodland book cover for chapter 2 of Mr. PinPin. Exactly two hedgehogs, young PinPin and old Master Shipostav, have a kind quiet conversation outside the elder's root-burrow home at the foot of Burrow Hill.
Input images: Image 1 is the style/layout/typography reference ONLY: match its rich dimensional woodland miniature realism, detailed plants, graceful substantial dark-green storybook serif title integrated into open sky in the upper third; do not include tractor or logs. Image 2 establishes Burrow Hill environment and the two-character size relationship. Image 3 establishes Master Shipostav's precise face, silver-gray quills, cream face, round gold spectacles, natural low hedgehog body and curved bramble staff resting nearby.
Scene/backdrop: Ferns, tiny white woodland flowers, mossy rocks, ancient oak roots framing a small natural burrow opening; the hill and distant leafy woodland beyond. Use a low animal-height camera, ground-level intimate storybook feeling, open softly blue sky upper third enclosed by leafy branches at edges.
Subject: young PinPin on left and elderly Master Shipostav on right, facing each other with warm clear three-quarter faces, both faces visible, friendly attentive eyes. Elder slightly larger than young PinPin but both convincingly small hedgehogs among the flowers; naturally grounded bodies. PinPin has warm brown quills and cream face as in Image 1, no clothing or spectacles. Elder has silvery quills and round gold spectacles as in Image 3; his curved bramble staff leans beside the root entrance. Exactly two hedgehogs, each with coherent two forelimb and two hindlimb attachments, with natural occlusion; no human hands, no duplicate paws.
Composition: typography occupies upper third; large richly drawn hedgehogs in lower-middle area, burrow behind elder, foreground moss/ferns/path along bottom. Match the reference cover's polished full-bleed depth, restrained natural contrast, believable warm sunlight and storybook charm. No panel, border, banner or blank white margins.
Text (verbatim), elegant large dark forest-green serif lettering integrated into sky: first line "Мистер Пин-Пин"; below it the chapter title "Мудрость Старейшины". The second title may wrap across two well-balanced lines. This is all text; no extra word, author, chapter number or badge. Spell every Cyrillic letter correctly. Clear readable title with ample breathing space and no branches crossing letters.
Constraints: preserve the elder identity and established root-burrow setting, exactly two hedgehogs, no other animals, no tractor, no clothes, no extra limbs, no watermark.

references.role: style, layout and typography reference only

review: Full-image visual review: exact Russian title is readable and matches requested spelling. Two hedgehogs face each other; PinPin is smaller and brown-quilled, elder silver-quilled with round spectacles and nearby curved staff. Natural root burrow and distant hill retained. No visible duplicate forelimb attachments; hidden hindlimbs cannot be certified. Warm dimensional full-bleed style matches tractor cover. Candidate only.

approval.evidence: User accepted the presented chapter covers and standardization: perfect. good job.
